purpose: Reference Grade 1-6 teacher cards showing the intended stage-safe MathBridge output before UI implementation.

zh.what_is_taught: 中国第一学段在数的认识中发展数数和数序；英格兰 Year 1 明确要求从任意给定数字继续向前、向后数。
zh.difference: 两边都发展数序，但英格兰把‘从任意数开始数’和向后数写得更明确。
zh.classroom_use: 不要总从1开始。让学生从47、55或98开始向前或向后数。

en.what_is_taught: China Learning Stage 1 develops counting and number sequence within early number work; England Year 1 explicitly counts forwards and backwards from given numbers.
en.difference: Both develop number sequence, while England makes arbitrary starting points and backward counting more explicit.
en.classroom_use: Do not always start from 1. Start from 47, 55 or 98 and count forwards or backwards.

cards.evidence_rule: China stage + England statutory year; no exact China semester claim

zh.what_is_taught: 中国第一学段发展万以内数的意义和位值；Common Core Grade 2 明确发展百、十、一的位值关系。
zh.difference: Common Core把位值直接连接到百、十、一和运算策略；中国国家课程在学段层面规定更广的数与运算要求。
zh.classroom_use: 用位值学具、数字写法和数轴同时表示一个数，并说明每个数位表示多少。

en.what_is_taught: China Learning Stage 1 develops number meaning and place value within 10,000; Common Core Grade 2 explicitly develops hundreds, tens and ones.
en.difference: Common Core directly connects place value to base-ten units and strategies, while China's national standard states the broader requirement at learning-stage level.
en.classroom_use: Represent one number with place-value materials, numeral notation and a number line, and explain each place value.

cards.evidence_rule: No automatic claim that the whole Stage 1 requirement is specifically introduced in Grade 2

zh.what_is_taught: 中国第二学段学习面积和面积单位；Common Core Grade 3 明确定义面积为用单位正方形测量的属性，并连接到乘法。
zh.difference: Common Core把单位方格、阵列和乘法关系写得非常直接。
zh.classroom_use: 先铺单位方格，再从逐格数过渡到行数×每行格数。

en.what_is_taught: China Learning Stage 2 develops area and area units; Common Core Grade 3 explicitly defines area using unit squares and connects it with multiplication.
en.difference: Common Core makes the unit-square, array and multiplication connection especially explicit.
en.classroom_use: Cover the region with unit squares first, then move from counting each square to rows × squares per row.

cards.evidence_rule: Selected China Grade 3 is a navigation context; the national requirement is Stage 2 unless current textbook placement is verified

zh.what_is_taught: 中国第二学段学习周长和面积；英格兰从 Year 3 正式测量和计算简单图形周长。
zh.difference: 英格兰课程把周长和面积的区别持续放在测量问题中；中国同样在小学阶段发展这两个量。
zh.classroom_use: 同一个图形用线标出周长、用方格铺出面积，让学生说清两个量和单位的区别。

en.what_is_taught: China Learning Stage 2 develops perimeter and area; England formally measures and calculates simple perimeter from Year 3.
en.difference: England repeatedly distinguishes perimeter from area within measurement work; China also develops both attributes in primary mathematics.
en.classroom_use: On the same shape, mark perimeter with a line and area with square units, then explain why the quantities and units differ.

cards.evidence_rule: Different grade numbers are acceptable; do not label England Year 3 as equivalent to China Grade 4

comparison.placement: Year 4-6 progression; systematic factor work Year 5

zh.what_is_taught: 中国第三学段学习因数、公因数等数的结构；英格兰 Year 4 开始使用因数对，Year 5 系统找因数和公因数。
zh.difference: 英格兰把因数结构与乘法事实和后续分数工作逐步连接。
zh.classroom_use: 用24个点排出所有长方形阵列，从每个阵列读出一对因数。

en.what_is_taught: China Learning Stage 3 develops factors and common factors; England uses factor pairs from Year 4 and systematically finds factors/common factors in Year 5.
en.difference: England progressively links factor structure with multiplication facts and later fraction work.
en.classroom_use: Arrange 24 dots into every possible rectangle and read one factor pair from each array.

cards.evidence_rule: China exact Grade 5/6 textbook split remains pending

zh.what_is_taught: 中国第三学段学习比、比例和比例关系；Common Core Grade 6 设有 Ratio and Proportional Relationships 领域。
zh.difference: Common Core Grade 6 把比、单位率、等比表和比例推理组织成一个明确领域。
zh.classroom_use: 写2:3之前，先用完整语言说‘每2个A对应3个B’，再用表格或双数轴扩展等值比。

en.what_is_taught: China Learning Stage 3 develops ratio, proportion and proportional relationships; Common Core Grade 6 has a dedicated Ratio and Proportional Relationships domain.
en.difference: Common Core Grade 6 organises ratio, unit rate, equivalent-ratio representations and proportional reasoning into one explicit domain.
en.classroom_use: Before writing 2:3, say '2 of A for every 3 of B', then extend equivalent ratios with a table or double number line.

cards.evidence_rule: China Grade 6 selection is stage-safe; exact current PEP unit placement remains pending

checks: Every card states China learning-stage status when exact current textbook placement is unverified.
No card equates same-numbered China/England/Common Core grades automatically.
Each card resolves one classroom task.
Each card has Chinese and English stored wording.
Comparison wording remains descriptive, not evaluative.
